visual.general_description: Line chart of POMS factor scores for four assessment points across five mood factors.
visual.detailed_description: A white plot area with dotted gridlines titled POMS Scores. The y-axis is labeled Score with ticks 0 to 80 in steps of 10, and a red dashed horizontal line is drawn at 50. The x-axis lists Tension, Depression, Vigour, Anger and Fatigue. A legend below names four colored lines: Session 2 in green, Session 5 in blue, 3-month follow up in orange and 6-month follow up in purple. The green line is near 54 for Tension, 50 for Depression, 30 for Vigour, about 40 for Anger and 65 for Fatigue. The blue line is near 33, 10, 50, 22 and 45. The orange and purple lines are lowest for Tension, Depression, Anger and Fatigue and peak near 75 and 70 for Vigour. No patient names are visible.
